newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Time revises issue price of new shares.
newsitem.headline: Time revises issue price of new shares.

text.p: Time Engineering Bhd said on Tuesday the company, Sapura Telecommunications Bhd and Uniphone Telecommunications Bhd have agreed to revise the issue price of new Time shares for the acquisition of two telecommunications companies.
A statement issued by Time's merchant bankers on Tuesday said the issue price has been revised to 4.95 ringgit from 6.50 ringgit per share.
Accordingly, Time's proposed acquisition of a 75 percent stake in Sapura Digital Sdn Bhd for 750 million ringgit will now be paid by issuing 151.52 million new shares.
Time's purchase of 75 percent interest in Uniphone Sdn Bhd for 450 million ringgit will now be paid by the issue of 90.91 million new shares, the statement said.
The compensation of 20 million ringgit for the termination by Uniphone Sdn Bhd of its management agreement with Sapura Holdings Sdn Bhd will now be paid an issue of 4.04 million new shares.

It said the revised share issue price was arrived at after considering, among others, the closing market price of Time shares as at November 1 of 4.92 ringgit, and the average market price of Time shares from August 2 to November 1 of 5.07 ringgit.
Time's share capital will increase to 746.41 million ringgit from 499.95 million after the acquisitions.
Time shares closed at 4.92 ringgit on Tuesday.
